description: This file defines Keystone schema for a 'Post' list, including fields, access controls, validation, hooks, and grouping of related fields.

methods.name: resolveInput
methods.description: Hook to set createdBy and updatedBy fields based on request context during create and update operations.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validation functions to prevent profanity in title, content, feedback, and prevent deletion if preventDelete is true.

methods.name: beforeOperation
methods.description: Hook executed before create, update, or delete operations, logging the operation.

methods.name: afterOperation
methods.description: Hook executed after create, update, or delete operations, logging the results.
